prompt:
STYLE REDRAW of this exact character as a CLEAN SIMPLE GAME ICON.
The current image is far too noisy: hundreds of little triangular color fragments on the hair, cloak and clothes. Redraw the ENTIRE figure with dramatically fewer and larger coherent color shapes. This is not a blur/filter pass and not more crystal faceting.

LOCK all design choices: same gentle youthful face, head/body proportions, raised EMPTY hand, three-quarter left pose, silver hair, two swept purple butterfly antennas, modest ivory/purple Chinese cross-collar outfit with short layered skirt and fully opaque purple leggings, boots, small yin-yang clasp, large triangular purple butterfly cloak and two long leaf-tipped tails. No floating effects, balls or talismans. Keep full silhouette and current color family.

STRICT VISUAL SIMPLIFICATION:
- SILVER HAIR: 3–4 large locks. Each lock uses one solid ivory-white base plus ONE broad continuous lavender shadow shape, optionally one wide highlight region. Remove every tiny triangle, fleck, shard, strand-line, patch and texture. Hair should read as calm flowing masses.
- PURPLE CLOAK: each large side panel uses ONE solid purple main plane, ONE broad dark-purple turned plane and at most ONE broad lighter plane. Absolutely no mosaic tessellation inside those planes. Keep the large cyan/lavender butterfly pattern as clean flat uninterrupted shapes following the cloth. Each long tail is one dark ribbon shape and one simple flat eye marking.
- CLOTHING: 2 tones per material, a few major folds only. Combine dozens of tiny folds into 2–3 broad shapes. Keep clear cross-collar, sash and skirt panel edges, simplified and intentional.
- ANTENNAS/BOOTS: base plus one shadow; no jewel micro-facets.
- FACE/HANDS: gentle simple cartoon features, flat warm skin plus one quiet shadow. Preserve expression and proper anatomy. No grain, blush speckles, realistic iris or shiny skin.
- YIN-YANG clasp and cloud motif remain simple flat graphic marks with minimal shading.

A polished hand-drawn icon illustration with strong clean dark-violet outside contours, sparse inner contours, flat opaque fills, decisive large cel-shaded value blocks and slightly organic edge character. Keep a little three-dimensional form through BIG planes only. The result should remain clean at small game-icon scale. No noise, grain, paper texture, brush speckle, stipple, hatching, distressed edges, polygon mosaic, dense facets, sparkles, soft airbrush gradients or glossy 3D effects. Do not add detail to compensate for removing texture.
Make the improvement very visible: at least two-thirds fewer internal color boundaries than the input, large quiet uninterrupted areas of purple and white.
Same complete square composition on perfectly uniform warm ivory background, with all antennas, cloak tails and feet inside the canvas. No text, border, extra objects or cropped body. Output one finished clean character.
purpose: Full clean icon-style redraw, consolidating fragmented facets and texture into large quiet color planes.
visual_review: Hair, cloak, clothing and antenna shading consolidated into broad clean color regions; dense triangular fragments removed. Empty raised palm and established full silhouette retained.
